Within misc, misc-almost-type-3 has 1 word. Its only member is Job 15:35: its word וְיָ֣לֹֽד אָ֑וֶן has a final closed syllable with ḥolam, a long vowel. It fits CoS's broader type (a), but not our type 3, which is restricted to tsere.

Within misc, the vayomer subset has 4 words. Each has one paseq between the meteg-bearing word and the following word: the gaʿya-before-paseq pattern described in ITM §325. The table above shows that context.
